name: Da Lat Education College
kicker: Colonnade and bell tower on Yersin
summary: Stop at the gate on Yersin for the long curved colonnade and the bell tower of the teachers' college, one of the hill-station buildings you see from the street. Fifteen minutes is enough, and it is free from the pavement.

notice.title: Stay at the gate
notice.body: It is a working college. The visit is the colonnade and the bell tower from the street.

body: On Yersin, stop at the gate for the curved colonnade and the bell tower. Fifteen minutes is the outside look.
It is a working college, so stay on the pavement and do not walk into the halls during term.

figures.caption: The bell tower above the colonnade
figures.alt: Bell tower of Da Lat Education College

gettingThere: The college faces Yersin. Walk from the lake side of town along that street.
admissionNote: Free from the street. No visitor ticket. Interior visits are Check on arrival.
